column1: Gross Margin Analysis by Product Line - Acme Manufacturing Inc.
COST OF GOODS SOLD BY PRODUCT LINE
1. MARGIN COMPRESSION: Blended gross margin declining 440bps over 3 years (45.1% to 40.7%).
Driven by: (a) mix shift toward lower-margin Custom/Project work
(b) raw material cost increases not fully passed through
2. CUSTOM PROJECT GROWTH: Custom/Project revenue grew from $0 to $830K (+173%) in 2 years.
This is non-recurring revenue at 17% gross margin vs 48%+ for core products.
Mix shift is diluting reported gross margins meaningfully.
3. LEGACY SERIES WIND-DOWN: Revenue declining -40% over period with margins falling.
Management has not formalized a sunset plan. Inventory risk as units age.
4. SERVICE REVENUE BRIGHT SPOT: Service & Maintenance grew from $310K to $520K (+68%)
at 76% gross margin. Highest-quality revenue segment.
NOTE: Input costs have outpaced price increases for 3 consecutive years.
Management has not fully offset commodity inflation with pricing.
